pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 那 (nà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger brother
   B. Older sister
   C. Older brother
   D. That

2. What does 你 (nǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Classmates
   B. You
   C. I, me
   D. And you? (a question word)

3. What does 家 (jiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Home, family
   B. Daughter
   C. Older sister
   D. Son

4. Which is an activity at a birthday party? (1 mark)
   A. 上学 going to school
   B. 刮风 the wind blows
   C. 洗手 washing hands
   D. 切蛋糕 cutting the cake

5. Which sentence means "Who is this?"? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我爸爸。
   B. 我家有五口人。
   C. 这是谁?
   D. 那是我哥哥。

6. How many strokes does 妈 have? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 6
   D. 8

7. What does 雪 (xuě) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cloud
   B. Flood
   C. There is not
   D. Snow

8. What does 风很大 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is very strong
   B. The cloud is light
   C. The rain is heavy
   D. The sun is small

9. Which word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. 旁边
   B. 里
   C. 下面
   D. 上面

10. What does 左边 (zuǒbian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sofa
   B. Left side
   C. Living room
   D. Window

11. Which Chinese word means "ten"? (1 mark)
   A. 三 sān
   B. 九 jiǔ
   C. 十 shí
   D. 五 wǔ

12. Which sentence means "We sing."? (1 mark)
   A. 我们切蛋糕。
   B. 你生日是几月几号?
   C. 祝你生日快乐!
   D. 我们唱歌。

13. What does 耳朵 (ěrduo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ear
   B. Shoulder
   C. Tooth
   D. Knee

14. What does 风来了 fēng lái le mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is big
   B. The rain has come
   C. The wind has come
   D. The snow is white

15. Fill the blank: 我用眼睛____。 (I use my eyes to see.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 喝
   C. 听
   D. 看

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing. (2 marks)

17. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes." (3 marks)

18. Explain one way each of these family members might help you: 妈妈 and 哥哥. Then say one way you help them. (4 marks)

19. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 上面, 周 and 同学们. (3 marks)

20. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — That
   那 (nà) means that.

2. B — You
   你 (nǐ) means you.

3. A — Home, family
   家 (jiā) means home, family.

4. D — 切蛋糕 cutting the cake
   切蛋糕 is cut the cake.

5. C — 这是谁?
   这是谁? (zhè shì shéi?) means "Who is this?".

6. C — 6
   女 has 3 strokes and 马 has 3.

7. D — Snow
   雪 (xuě) means snow.

8. A — The wind is very strong
   风 is wind and 很大 is very big or strong.

9. A — 旁边
   旁边 pángbiān is beside.

10. B — Left side
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

11. C — 十 shí
   十 (shí) means ten.

12. D — 我们唱歌。
   我们唱歌。 (wǒmen chànggē.) means "We sing.".

13. A — Ear
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

14. C — The wind has come
   风 is wind and 来了 is has come.

15. D — 看
   看 is to see.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have two eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: mum cooks and cares for us; an older brother helps with homework; I help by washing the dishes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each helper, 1 mark for how, 1 mark for your own help. Any sensible answer.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: 上面: shàngmiàn, above. 周: zhōu, week (short form). 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
